title: PaySaathi white UI redesign and demo transaction receipts
notes: Rebuilt the Android customer experience with a clean white theme and refreshed navigation.
Added a welcome/onboarding screen before sign-in and account creation.
Redesigned login, sign-up, OTP, dashboard, service forms, profile and notifications.
Added local demo transaction confirmation with a success animation-style receipt and clearly marked TEST ONLY transaction reference.
Demo receipts are not real payments or operator confirmations; live provider integration is still required.
